description.p: Dimly controls your external monitor's real backlight from the desktop, so you can stop reaching for its buttons. It keeps the monitor in step with your laptop screen and dims both on a schedule, for long working days that are easier on your eyes.

ul.li: Brightness and contrast sliders, plus one-click Night, Evening, Day and Max presets you can adjust
Your laptop's brightness keys change the external monitors too
A top-bar menu, and keyboard shortcuts for brighter and dimmer
Switches preset by time of day; a change you make yourself lasts until the next switch
Newly connected monitors join in automatically
Factory reset for monitors whose backlight has stopped dimming

description.p: Dimly talks to monitors over DDC/CI using ddcutil. Most desktop monitors support it, though some USB-C docks and adapters don't pass it through.

ul.li: Top-bar menu with brightness, contrast and presets, so you don't need to open the window
The window's contrast slider also follows changes made elsewhere
Sliders follow brightness changes made with the shortcuts, the schedule or the laptop's keys while the window is open
Preset levels can be edited in the window
